snippet.title: This Nottingham Delivery Was TIGHT 😳🚛
snippet.description:
Come with me for another quick day in the life of a UK truck driver. 🚛

Today’s delivery was in Nottingham, and getting into the unloading area was a bit of a mission thanks to how the cars were parked. Somehow I managed to squeeze in without touching the red car. 😂

Then I found out the unload was going to take around 3½ hours, so out came the e-bike and I headed into town to grab some lunch. 🚲

Found a chicken and rice place, rode back to the truck, watched some TV while they finished unloading, then headed off to find somewhere to park for the night.

Only nine hours off before doing it all again the next morning.

snippet.description:
গণঅভ্যুত্থানে ক্ষমতাচ্যুত শেখ হাসিনার নিজ জেলা গোপালগঞ্জে কার্যক্রম নিষিদ্ধ আওয়ামী লীগ নেতাকর্মীদের বিক্ষোভ-সহিংসতার পর নড়েচড়ে বসেছে বিএনপি সরকার। জেলা প্রশাসক, পুলিশ সুপারের পর তিনটি থানার ওসির পদে রদবদল করা হয়েছে। পাশাপাশি আইনশৃঙ্খলা বাহিনীর বিপুল সংখ্যক সদস্য মোতায়েন করা হয়েছে। তবে বিক্ষোভ-সহিংসতার পরদিনও স্বাভাবিক হয়নি জেলাটির পরিস্থিতি। সোমবার নতুন করে কোনো বিক্ষোভ-সহিংসতার ঘটনা না ঘটলেও গোটা গোপালগঞ্জ জেলায় থমথমে পরিস্থিতি বিরাজ করছে বলে জানা গেছে।
*******************************************
বিবিসি নিউজ বাংলার ইউটিউব চ্যানেলে আপনাকে স্বাগতম। নিয়মিত ভিডিও আপডেট পেতে এবং অনুষ্ঠান দেখতে সাবস্ক্রাইব করতে ভুলবেন না!

snippet.description:
Форма птичьих яиц — результат длительной эволюции, в ходе которой сформировался баланс между прочностью скорлупы, особенностями откладывания и условиями развития зародыша. Квадратные яйца имели бы острые углы, которые могли бы создавать участки повышенной концентрации механического напряжения. Это потенциально увеличивало бы вероятность повреждения скорлупы при нагрузке.

Однако круглые яйца тоже не идеальны: на наклонной поверхности они могут легко укатиться далеко от гнезда. Удлинённая яйцевидная форма позволяет некоторым яйцам катиться по дуге, а не двигаться по прямой линии. Особенно хорошо эта особенность выражена у птиц, которые откладывают яйца на скалистых уступах.

При этом форма яиц зависит от вида птицы, анатомии яйцевода и особенностей формирования скорлупы. Она не возникла исключительно для того, чтобы яйца не укатывались, а сформировалась под воздействием множества эволюционных факторов.

Таким образом, яйцевидная форма — интересный пример того, как биологические особенности организмов формируются под влиянием физических ограничений и естественного отбора.

snippet.title: Imran Khan's Open Letter to Top Judges: Biggest Appeal to Supreme Court For Urgent Medical Treatment
snippet.description:
Imran Khan's Open Letter to Chief Justices  Medical Treatment for Imran Khan & Bushra Bibi  Adiala Jail Latest News

A major development has emerged from Adiala Jail as incarcerated PTI founder and former prime minister Imran Khan has written an open letter to the Chief Justices of Pakistan's Supreme Court, Federal Constitutional Court and Islamabad High Court, appealing for medical treatment for himself and his wife, Bushra Bibi, and implementation of previous court orders.

The letter, dated November 16, 2026, was shared by his lawyer Barrister Salman Safdar. According to the letter, Imran Khan gave his instructions to Salman Safdar during their meeting at Adiala Jail on November 11, which lasted approximately three hours.

1. Imran Khan's Open Letter to the Chief Justices

In his letter, Imran Khan has raised concerns about prolonged solitary confinement, limited access to family members and lawyers, and the non-implementation of court orders.

He states that his weekly meetings with his wife have repeatedly been skipped and that he has not been allowed to communicate with his sons. He also raises concerns about the reported custody of his three sisters.

Imran Khan has appealed to the top judges for justice, implementation of existing judicial orders and proper medical treatment for himself and Bushra Bibi.

2. Imran Khan's Health Blood Pressure and Medical Concerns

The letter raises serious concerns about Imran Khan's health while in Adiala Jail.

According to his account, his blood pressure readings have reached 192 and 193 on November 10, 2026. He says doctors have warned him about the risk of a brain haemorrhage and cardiac arrest, and that his heart has already suffered damage.

Imran Khan also refers to his age of 74 and expresses fear that his deteriorating health could put his life at risk.

These medical concerns are presented in the open letter and have not been independently verified through a new medical report in the material discussed here.

3. Bushra Bibi's Eyesight and Medical Treatment

A significant portion of the letter concerns Bushra Bibi's health.

Imran Khan states that Bushra Bibi suffered a detached retina in April 2026 and underwent complicated eye surgery. He claims that after the surgery she was returned to solitary confinement and that her medical records were withheld.

He has requested proper medical treatment for his wife and raised concerns about the possible permanent loss of her eyesight.

4. Supreme Court's August 18 Order Shifa International Hospital

Imran Khan refers to a three-member Supreme Court bench's order dated August 18, 2026.

According to the letter, the Supreme Court had directed that he be shifted to Shifa International Hospital within two days, that a medical board including a cardiologist and an eye specialist examine him, and that he be allowed weekly family meetings and telephone calls with his sons twice a week.

He alleges that these directions have not been implemented. He says the matter is now pending before the Federal Constitutional Court.

5. Al-Qadir Trust Case Appeal and Judicial Proceedings

Imran Khan has also raised concerns about the scheduling of his Al-Qadir Trust appeal.

In the letter, he questions why the £190 million Al-Qadir appeal is being taken up out of turn ahead of older appeals, while his health concerns and previous court orders have allegedly not received similar attention.

He argues that his legal proceedings and medical needs should receive appropriate consideration.

6. Appeal for Justice and Medical Treatment

Concluding his letter, Imran Khan says he is not seeking any special favour. He has appealed for the implementation of Supreme Court orders and proper medical treatment for himself and Bushra Bibi.

He has urged the Chief Justices to intervene on humanitarian grounds and ensure that the relevant judicial directions are implemented.
